summary.answer: Builds an FFA result bar with emblem, sanitized name and points model links. NoPlayers, Hidden and IsLocalPlayer are stored predicates; team-count/row subscriptions request reevaluation. It displays a result and does not award or persist it. Creates self via LUI.UIElement.new, SceneBlur via LUI.UIImage.new, DarkBacking via LUI.UIImage.new, NoiseTiledBacking via LUI.UIImage.new, Frame via CoD.StartMenuOptionsMainFrame.new, EmblemBacking via LUI.UIImage.new, EmblemBacking3 via LUI.UIImage.new, EmblemBacking2 via LUI.UIImage.new, GlowTexture via LUI.UIImage.new, Glow via LUI.UIImage.new, Emblem via LUI.UIImage.new, Name via LUI.UIText.new, PlaceBanner via LUI.UIImage.new, GlowSphere via LUI.UIImage.new, GlowRing via LUI.UIImage.new, PlaceText via LUI.UIText.new, BGDotPatternLarge via LUI.UIImage.new, Score via LUI.UIText.new, TiledShaderImage1 via LUI.UIImage.new, TiledShaderImage2 via LUI.UIImage.new, TiledShaderImage3 via LUI.UIImage.new, UnderLine1 via LUI.UIImage.new, UnderLine2 via LUI.UIImage.new, UnderLine3 via LUI.UIImage.new. Stores state predicates NoPlayers, Hidden, IsLocalPlayer; their body effects require state-system evaluation.
